column1: # What skills/ask-team/hooks/merge-guard.py refuses and allows. Columns, tab-separated:
# expected (refused or allowed); the repo: "workflow" has a project map, "plain" has none;
# the branch the repo is on; the tool; the tool's command or name ("\n" is a line break).
# The repo's origin/HEAD points at main, or at trunk on the "trunk" rows.

column5: gh pr view 5; gh pr merge 5
gh api -X POST repos/owner/repo/merges -f base=main -f head=feature-x
gh api graphql -f query='mutation { mergePullRequest(input: {pullRequestId: "x"}) { clientMutationId } }'
gh api graphql -f query='mutation { enablePullRequestAutoMerge(input: {pullRequestId: "x"}) { clientMutationId } }'
git add . && git commit -m "x" && git push origin main
gh api graphql -f query='mutation { deleteBranchProtectionRule(input: {branchProtectionRuleId: "x"}) { clientMutationId } }'

column1: # Less common spellings: glued options, API variants, GraphQL from files, aliases, PowerShell

column5: gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/pulls/$(gh pr view --json number -q .number)/merge
gh api graphql -f query='mutation { enqueuePullRequest(input: {pullRequestId: "x"}) { clientMutationId } }'
gh api graphql -f query='mutation { createCommitOnBranch(input: {branch: {branchName: "main"}}) { clientMutationId } }'
gh api graphql -f query='mutation { updateRepository(input: {repositoryId: "x", defaultBranch: "feature-x"}) { clientMutationId } }'
gh api -X PATCH repos/o/r/git/refs/heads/main -f sha=abc -F force=true
gh api -X POST repos/o/r/git/refs -f ref=refs/heads/main -f sha=abc
gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/contents/README.md -f message=x -f content=eA== -f branch=main
gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/contents/README.md -f message=x -f content=eA==
gh api repos/o/r/issues/5/comments -f body='See branches/main/protection in the docs'
gh api repos/o/r/pulls/5/reviews -f event=COMMENT -f body='The ruleset is at rulesets/42'
gh api graphql -f query='query { repository(owner: "o", name: "r") { branchProtectionRules(first: 5) { nodes { pattern } } } }'
gh api -X PUT repos/o/r/contents/README.md -f message=x -f content=eA== -f branch=feature-x
gh pr create -b "Merge this after the review" -t "Add x"
gh pr review 5 --comment -b "Looks right; the developer merges"

column1: # Indirect pushes: refspecs, git settings, aliases, variables, eval, wrappers

column5: GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=remote.origin.push GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=HEAD:refs/heads/main git push origin
git rebase -x 'git push origin HEAD:main' HEAD~1
git submodule foreach 'git push origin HEAD:main'
env -u FOO git push origin HEAD:main
timeout -s KILL 60 git push origin HEAD:main
echo HEAD:main | xargs git push origin
bash scripts/build.sh && git push -u origin feature-x

column1: # Unreadable commands that name a merge are refused

column5: gh pr create --base main --title "Add x" --body "Run gh pr merge 5 after review"
gh api graphql -f query='query { repository(owner: "o", name: "r") { pullRequest(number: 5) { mergeable } } }'
git commit -m "Explain why gh pr merge stays the developer's act"
git commit -F - <<'EOF'\nNever run gh pr merge 5 or git push origin main\nEOF

column1: # Allowed: a repo not set up with the workflow, which the guard leaves alone
# A command aimed at a workflow repo from elsewhere is still refused

column5: cd WORKFLOW && git push origin main
